changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: Rename the call pools whose slug starts with own- before upgrading
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM llm_call_pool WHERE slug LIKE 'own-%'

changeSet.comment: The pool that the database makes for a model takes a slug with this prefix.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A pool learns its limit from the provider and derives the conversation reserve from it, so the reserve no longer is a setting.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Every model has a call pool. The database gives a model its own when it has none, whichever path wrote it, and ends that pool with the model or its move to a shared pool.
